scope: Independent finite review of only the new literal-listed-URI adapter and planner changes, and the five added tests. No scientific content reread or 48-record metadata assessment.

checks.area: exact source pins and isolated module
checks.evidence: All required pinned source bytes are verified into a complete list before the compile loop. Only the loaded summary-side module.safe_url is replaced after compilation; original collector files and shared coordinator code are unchanged.

checks.area: public-origin validation plus literal request URI
checks.evidence: The retained pinned safe_url validator runs first. Valid requests preserve original scheme and www host, quote the raw path without introducing canonical aliases, preserve query, and remove fragment. file/local/IP/credentials/nonordinary ports remain rejected by the pinned validator.

checks.area: robots and page redirects under shared lock
checks.evidence: Mocked transport asserts held == [url] for each actual HTTP robots request, HTTPS robots redirect target, HTTP page, and HTTPS page redirect target. Source request remains HTTP; only observed 301 contributes the redirect chain and HTTPS final URL.

Admission requires exact packet.listedWebsite == reviewed url and a matching relatedCapture tuple for actual requested URI, final source URL, original observedAt and body SHA. Host/path/query are constrained; hydrate must succeed, page identity must be confirmed, transport must be ok, accepted_lab_group must hold, and listed URL must not already have been directly checked. Hydrate retains the unresolved mismatch exclusion.

checks.area: actual request availability and denial boundary
checks.evidence: The literal-listed-gap namespace deduplicates by request_key, separately from content-folded discoveries. Availability uses meta.sourceUrl (through checked_url/request_key) rather than a capture dictionary URL or final-URL content key, so an HTTPS related capture cannot close an HTTP original request gap. An actual original-URI robots denial stays access_boundary_do_not_bypass with no live candidate.

The five added tests cover original HTTP/www preservation and public rejection, actual HTTP page/robots redirects with locks, supported research not closing an original-address gap, stale capture/mismatch rejection, and original-address access-denial no-retry behavior.

tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_local_lab_shared_adapter.py -v
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_local_lab_summaries.py -v

limitations: Production plan() was not run: it materializes gap-plan.json. Planner execution was verified only with isolated temporary test fixtures.

The 48 real related-address metadata associations and their reviewed-listed-url-gaps.json decisions belong to the separately assigned review; this report assesses the admission mechanism, not those individual decisions.
No live HTTP behavior was exercised; redirect and gate behavior was verified through mocked transport and gate fixtures.
